title: Microsoft 365 outage leads to chlorine gas poisoning of 15 hotel guests
why_read: A striking real-world case of software failure causing physical harm, illustrating how fragile safety-critical dependencies on cloud services can be.
analysis: The headline describes a hotel incident where guests were poisoned by chlorine gas, seemingly connected to a Microsoft 365 outage affecting some control or monitoring system tied to pool or water treatment chemicals. This is notable as a cautionary tale about over-reliance on cloud software for safety-critical physical processes, a topic relevant to engineers building IoT or industrial control systems. It is more of a human-interest and systems-reliability story than a deep technical one, but the implications for designing resilient safety systems are real.
